cases.question: Tell me about Pdfroo
cases.judge_reason: All claims match the expected facts and known public details about Pdfroo.
cases.answer:
**Pdfroo** is Ayush's fully client-side PDF editor — open a PDF in your browser, annotate, sign, rearrange/merge pages, find & replace text, compress, and download a real flattened PDF. Nothing ever leaves your device; all parsing, rendering, and writing happen locally via **pdf.js + pdf-lib**, and it works offline once loaded.

**Highlights**
- **Zero backend** — no build step, no install, runs from `file://` or any static server
- **Responsive** — phone (375 px), tablet (768 px), desktop (1440 px+) with mouse, pen, or touch
- **Pages panel** — thumbnail sidebar (desktop), slide-in drawer (tablet), bottom sheet (phone); drag to reorder (SortableJS), rotate, duplicate, delete, insert blank, merge from other PDFs
- **Privacy-first** — after first successful download, a kangaroo toast confirms: "Your PDF never left your device"
- **Landing page** — custom kangaroo mascot (SVG), local fonts, built-in sample PDF, shortcuts to Find & Replace and Compress

**Stack:** JavaScript, CSS, HTML (pdf.js, pdf-lib, SortableJS)  
**Live:** https://ayush4u.github.io/pdfroo/  
**Repo:** https://github.com/ayush4u/pdfroo (MIT)
